reproduction.note: Not the same evaluation point: the public release lacks 33 (modulation, SNR) groups, including AM-DSB and GFSK at 14 dB, so OWL scores at 12 dB, where a faithful run is expected about 1 point below the 14 dB peak. The model is a complex-convolution ResNet with basic blocks [3, 4, 6, 3] (the script calls it ResNet-50), not a Dense ResNet-68, and it is trained once rather than five times. Optimizer, learning rate, batch size, epochs and seeds are assumed. The script checks test accuracy after each epoch from epoch 11 for early stopping, but the stop never triggered, so all 20 epochs ran.
